info.title: InsightIDR API
info.description:
Introduction

Welcome to the reference documentation for the InsightIDR public APIs.

Here are a few resources to help you learn how to start using our APIs:

  • Learn about basic concepts and capabilities
  • Get an Insight platform API key to set up authentication
  • See available Insight product APIs
  • Learn more about InsightIDR

After you've got the basics down, you can use this API guide to find examples of requests and responses.

tags.name: Investigations
tags.description: An API used to search, access, and modify investigations. To learn more about investigations, see our documentation at: https://docs.rapid7.com/insightidr/investigations

put.summary: Set the status of an investigation
put.description: An API that sets the status of the investigation, which is specified by id or rrn. This API returns the investigation with its status updated to the new state. If the investigation already has the given status, no change is made, but the investigation will still be returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to be changed.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The new status for the investigation (case insensitive).

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

put.summary: Set the priority of an investigation
put.description: An API that sets the priority of the investigation, which is specified by id or rrn. This API returns the investigation with its priority updated to the new state. If the investigation already has the given priority, no change is made, but the investigation will still be returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to be changed.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: The new priority for the investigation (case insensitive).

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

put.summary: Set the disposition of an investigation
put.description: An API that sets the disposition of the investigation, which is specified by id or rrn This API returns the investigation with its disposition updated to the new state. If the investigation already has the given disposition, no change is made, but the investigation will still be returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to be changed.

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: The new disposition for the investigation (case insensitive).

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

put.description: An API that assigns a user to an investigation, specified by id or rrn. The user must be a platform administrator, product administrator, or read/write user with access to either InsightIDR or InsightUBA.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to assign the user to.

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

get.description: An API that retrieves a page of investigations matching the given request parameters. By default, this page of investigations will be sorted by investigation priority in descending order.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The 0-based index of the first page to retrieve. Must be an integer greater than 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of investigations to retrieve. Must be an integer greater than 0, or less than or equal to 100.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of investigation statuses to include in the result.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of investigation sources to include in the result.

parameters.name: priorities
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of investigation priorities to include in the result.

parameters.name: assignee.email
parameters.description: A user's email address.  Only investigations assigned to that user will be included.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The time an investigation is opened. Only investigations whose created_time is after this date will be returned by the API. Must be an ISO-formatted timestamp.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The time an investigation is closed. Only investigations whose created_time is before this date will be returned by the API. Must be an ISO-formatted timestamp.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field for investigations to be sorted by and their sort direction separated by a comma. Sortable fields are created_time,priority, rrn, alerts_most_recent_created_time, and alerts_most_recent_detection_created_time.

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, a user API key must be provided. Investigations will be returned from all organizations the calling user has access to.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of tags to include in the result. Only investigations who have all specified tags will be included.
parameters.example: Incident, Security Test, Reported to Customer, Potentially Unwanted Program

post.description: An API to manually create investigations. Creating an investigation requires a user API key in the request headers. Non-default investigation fields can be specified in the request body. The API returns the newly created investigation information in the response.

An API to bulk close all investigations that match the provided request parameters. This API returns the number of investigations that were closed and a list of their IDs.
 If there are any investigations found associated with Threat Command alerts within the given request parameters, they will be closed in Threat Command with the close reason, "Other".

parameters.description: The optional 0-based index of the page to retrieve.  Must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: size

get.description: An API to retrieve a specific investigation. This investigation is specified by either id or rrn.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to get investigation details.

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

patch.description: An API that updates multiple fields in a single operation for an investigation, specified by id or rrn. The investigation will be returned with its changed fields. Null or omitted fields will not have their values updated in the investigation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to update

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

get.summary: Get a list of Rapid7 product alerts associated with the specified investigation
get.description: An API to retrieve and list all Rapid7 product alerts associated with an investigation with the given id. These alerts are generated by Rapid7 products other than InsightIDR that you have an active license for.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The ID of the investigation.

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

get.summary: List alerts associated with the specified investigation
get.description: An API to retrieve and list all alerts associated with an investigation, with the given id or rrn. The listed alerts are sorted in descending order by alert create time.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The ID of the investigation.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The optional 0-based index of the page to retrieve. Must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The optional size of the page to retrieve. Must be an integer greater than 0, or less than or equal to 100.

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

delete.summary: Remove alert associated to an investigation
delete.description: An API that removes the association between an alert and an investigation, which is specified by id or rrn. If the investigation is not associated with the given alert, not found exception will be thrown.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The id or rrn of the investigation to be changed.

parameters.name: alertRrn
parameters.description: The rrn of the alert to be removed from the investigation.

parameters.name: multi-customer
parameters.description: Indicates whether the requester has multi-customer access. If set to true, the ID of the investigation must be in the RRN format, the region of the RRN must match the region of the endpoint, and a user API key must be provided.

InvestigationStatusRequestV2.description: Additional info to set when setting an investigation's status.

disposition.description: A disposition to set the investigation to. Only used if the new status is CLOSED. Defaults to UNDECIDED upon creation.

threat_command_close_reason.description: The Threat Command reason for closing, applicable only if the investigation being closed has an associated alert in Threat Command. The Close Reason description depends on the Threat Command alert type. To get this information, use: `getInvestigationRapid7ProductAlertInfo`.
enum: ProblemSolved, InformationalOnly, ProblemWeAreAlreadyAwareOf, NotRelatedToMyCompany, FalsePositive, LegitimateApplication/Profile, CompanyOwnedDomain, Other

threat_command_free_text.description: Additional information provided by the user when closing a Threat Command alert.

title.example: Jane Smith enabled account Roger Johnson

assignee.description: Information about the user assigned to this investigation (if any).

tags.description: The tags assigned to this investigation (if any).

responsibility.description: The responsibility of the investigation, which denotes who is responsible for performing the investigation. This field will only appear for Managed Detection & Response customers.

organizationId.description: The id of the organization that owns this investigation.

lastAccessed.description: The time this investigation was last viewed or modified.

createdTime.description: The time this investigation was created.

firstAlertTime.description: The create time of the first alert belonging to this investigation (if any).

latestAlertTime.description: The create time of the most recent alert belonging to this investigation (if any).

AssignUserToInvestigationRequestV2.description: Details about which user to assign.

user_email_address.description: The email address of the user to assign to this investigation, used to log into the insight platform.

email.description: The email address of the user to assign to this investigation, used to log into the insight platform.

CreateInvestigationRequestV2.description: This is the field information for the new investigation.

status.description: The status of the investigation. Defaults to OPEN.

priority.description: The priority for the investigation. Defaults to UNSPECIFIED.

disposition.description: The disposition for the investigation. Defaults to UNDECIDED.

assignee.description: The user assigned to this investigation.

BulkCloseInvestigationsRequestV2.description: The criteria for what investigations to close.

source.description: The name of an investigation source. Only investigations from this source will be closed. If the source is ALERT, an alert type or a detection rule RRN must be specified as well.

alert_type.description: The category of types of alerts that should be closed. This parameter is required if the source is ALERT and ignored for other sources. This description must exactly match the alert type returned by the List Investigations response.

disposition.description: A disposition to set the investigation to. Defaults to NOT_APPLICABLE.

detection_rule_rrn.description: The rrn of the detection rule. Only investigations that are associated with this detection rule will be closed. If a detection rule rrn is given, the alert_type is required to be 'Attacker Behavior Detected'.

from.description: The time investigations are to be closed from. Only investigations whose createTime is after this date will be closed. Must be an ISO-formatted timestamp.

to.description: The time investigations are to be closed by. Only investigations whose created_time is before this date will be closed. Must be an ISO-formatted timestamp.

max_investigations_to_close.description: An optional maximum number of alerts to close with this request. If this parameter is not specified then there is no maximum. If this limit is exceeded, then a 400 error response is returned. The minimum description is 0.

ids.description: The ids of the investigations that were closed by the request.

num_closed.description: The number of investigations closed by the request.

DatedSearchRequest.description: The criteria and sorting information for searching. Includes date filtering information.

search.description: The criteria for which entities to return.

start_time.description: An optional ISO formatted timestamp for the start of the time period to search for matching investigations. Only investigations whose created_time is after this date will be returned. If this field is omitted, this field will default to 28 days ago.

end_time.description: An optional ISO formatted timestamp for the end of the time period to search for matching investigations. Only investigations whose created_time is before this date will be returned. If this field is omitted, the field will default to the current time.

operator.description: The search operation to perform. All operators are case-insensitive when operating on Strings

order.description: The sorting direction. Sorting is case-insensitive when sorting Strings.

data.description: The list of data that matches the pagination parameters. If no results match, this will be an empty list.

metadata.description: The pagination parameters used to generate this page result.

index.description: The 0 based index of the page retrieved.

size.description: The size of the page requested.

total_pages.description: The total number of pages available with the given filter parameters.

total_data.description: The total number of results available with the given filter parameters.

UpdateInvestigationRequestV2.description: The updates to the investigation fields.

title.description: The new name of the investigation. The title will not update if omitted.

status.description: The new status for the investigations. The status will not update if omitted.

priority.description: The new priority for the investigation. The priority will not update if omitted.

disposition.description: The new disposition for the investigation. The disposition will not update if omitted.

assignee.description: The new user assigned to this investigation. To unassign a user, set email to null. The assignee will not update if the object is null or omitted.

threat_command_close_reason.description: The Threat Command reason for closing, applicable only if the investigation being closed has an associated alert in Threat Command. The Close Reason description depends on the Threat Command alert type. To get this information, use: `getInvestigationRapid7ProductAlertInfo`.
enum: ProblemSolved, InformationalOnly, ProblemWeAreAlreadyAwareOf, NotRelatedToMyCompany, FalsePositive, LegitimateApplication/Profile, CompanyOwnedDomain, Other

threat_command_free_text.description: Additional information provided by the user when closing a Threat Command alert.

alert_id.description: The unique identifier for this alert in the Insight Agent.

alert_type.description: The type of alert in the Insight Agent.

agent_action_taken.description: The action that was taken by the Insight Agent, as mentioned in this alert.

type.description: String representing the Rapid7 product which is associated with the investigation.

threat_command_details.description: Object representing the Threat Command alert associated with an investigation. This object will be present only when the Type field is set to 'THREAT_COMMAND'.

insight_agent_details.description: Object representing the Insight Agent alert associated with an investigation. This object will be present only when the Type field is set to 'INSIGHT AGENT'.

alert_id.description: The unique identifier for this alert in Threat Command.

alert_type.description: The type of alert in Threat Command.

applicable_close_reasons.description: The list of applicable close reasons, based on the alert type, that can be used to close an alert on Threat Command side.

ruleName.description: The name of the detection rule.
ruleName.example: Attacker Technique - Accessibility Tool Launching Process

ruleRrn.description: The rrn of the detection rule.

title.example: Account jdoe had INBOUND firewall traffic from 1.2.3.4 (tracked in MyThreat) to 10.1.2.3

alertTypeDescription.description: A description of this type of alert.
alertTypeDescription.example: A new account has been created.

createdTime.description: The time the alert was created.

firstEventTime.description: The time the first event involved in this alert occurred.

latestEventTime.description: The time the most recent event involved in this alert occurred.

detectionRuleRrn.description: The detection rule that generated this alert, if any.
